Title: NETMESSAGE:Rusty:\nCome on, everyone is waiting topside.
Translation: Rusty:\n快点，大家都在上面等着呢。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):\nThe next step is to destroy the nearby reactor to shut down defenses. But be careful,\nthe aliens may be attracted to the place due to the high energy concentration.
Translation: Sven Viking（无线电）:\n下一步是摧毁附近的反应堆以关闭防御。但要小心，\n外星人可能会因为高能量聚集而被吸引到这里。

Title:
NETMESSAGE:Soctom:
We have a problem. Nih and Adambean went inside and the elevator broke.
We can't follow them this way, they are on their own.
We have to find a way around the cliffs.
Translation:
Soctom:
我们遇到了问题。Nih和Adambean进去了，电梯坏了。
我们没法这样跟上他们，他们只能靠自己了。
我们必须找一条绕过悬崖的路。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Sniper:\nWatch out, enemy forces incoming from the rear! We will hold them off!\nCommandos, start climbing! Protector, get the osprey ready ASAP!
Translation: 狙击手:\n小心，敌军从后面来了！我们会挡住他们！\n突击队，开始攀登！护卫，尽快准备好鱼鹰！

Title: NETMESSAGE:edman747 (radio):\nShoot that chopper down already, we'll draw its fire! Joropito, Soctom... get a move on!
Translation: edman747（无线电）:\n快把那架直升机打下来，我们来吸引它的火力！Joropito, Soctom...赶紧行动！

Title:
NETMESSAGE:Joropito:
I'm overriding the security code for the door
so you will gain access to the lower laboratory.
Hold your pantsies!
Translation:
Joropito:
我正在覆盖门的安保密码
这样你们就能进入下层实验室了。
沉住气！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Joropito:\nDoor is open! Now you go on, we'll hop on the osprey.
Translation: Joropito:\n门开了！现在你们继续前进，我们跳上鱼鹰。
